pass_a_gloss: Former contest recalled; latter to perfect it; boldness kept unto promise.
pass_b_english: Paul says to those beginning the contest: 'Call to mind the former days, in which, enlightened, ye endured a great contest of sufferings; partly made a gazing-stock by reproaches and afflictions, partly fellows of those so used. For ye both sympathized with the prisoners and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing ye have for yourselves a better and abiding substance. Cast not away therefore your boldness, which hath great recompense. For ye have need of patience, that, doing God's will, ye may receive the promise.' You then, enlightened long ago, having endured the former contest — now perfect it by the latter, that, doing God's will through both, ye receive the promise (Hebrews 10:32–36).
